discovery.title: Find Your Controller
discovery.subtitle: Scanning your local network for ESP RGBWW controllers...
discovery.noNetwork: No network connection. Please connect to WiFi and try again.
discovery.noControllersFound: No controllers found on your network.

hostnameStep.title: Set Device Hostname
hostnameStep.subtitle: Choose a unique name to identify this device on your network
hostnameStep.label: Hostname
hostnameStep.hint: The hostname will be used to access the device on your local network

pinConfigStep.title: Configure Device Pins
pinConfigStep.subtitle: Select a pin configuration for your {soc} device
pinConfigStep.noConfigBody: No pre-configured pin layouts are available for your {soc} device. You can continue with the setup and configure the pins manually in the main interface later.
pinConfigStep.noConfigCaption: Pin configuration can be set up after completing the initial setup process.

colorModelStep.title: Configure Color Model
colorModelStep.subtitle: Select the color model and adjust color channels

telemetryStep.title: Telemetry
telemetryStep.statsBody: Allow anonymous statistics to be sent to the developer? This helps improving the firmware.
telemetryStep.logBody: Enable sending debug logs to the configured telemetry server?
telemetryStep.changeNote: You can change these settings at any time under Network Settings > Telemetry.
telemetryStep.dataNote: With this build, the following data is sent every 30s:

security.title: API Password Protection
security.description: Require a password for API access to this controller (HTTP and WebSocket).
security.passwordHint: Enter a new password, then press Set password

ipSettings.title: IP Settings
ipSettings.description: IP settings require a restart to take effect. If changed, controller will restart automatically.
ipSettings.gatewayRangeError: Gateway is not in the configured network range

mqtt.title: MQTT Settings
mqtt.description: MQTT settings require a restart to take effect. If changed, controller will restart automatically.
mqtt.nodeIdHint: Unique identifier for this device (defaults to controller name)

telemetry.title: Telemetry
telemetry.statsIntro: Telemetry is enabled by default in debug builds and disabled by default in release builds.
telemetry.statsStickyNote: But: once it has been enabled here, an update to a release build will not reset that.
telemetry.statsDescription: When enabled, telemetry stats will be sent to the configured URL. This data contains anonymized usage statistics to help improve the firmware.
telemetry.logDescription: When enabled, telemetry logs will be sent to the configured URL. This data contains log information to help debug and improve the firmware.
telemetry.dataNote: With this build, the following data is sent every 30s:

rsyslog.title: Rsyslog Settings
rsyslog.description: Configure UDP rsyslog forwarding for device logs. Changes apply after restart.
rsyslog.autoConfigNote: Auto-config is handled in Log Viewer. Edit manually here if needed.

firmwareUpdate.title: Firmware update
firmwareUpdate.otaUrlHint: URL to the firmware update server
firmwareUpdate.temporarilyUnavailable: {count} controller(s) marked temporarily unavailable after 3 ping attempts.
firmwareUpdate.reachableNotVisible: {count} controller(s) not flagged visible but reachable.

hostname.title: Hostname and Icon
hostname.allowWebIconsTooltip: When enabled, you can select icons from the Google Fonts library, but there is a risk of sending data to Google (IP address, browser, referrer etc).
hostname.enableWebIconsTooltip: Enable 'Allow Web Icons' to browse Google Fonts

webappUpdate.title: Webapp Update
webappUpdate.description: When enabled, checks for a new webapp on every WiFi connect. Disable to only update on manual request. A missing webapp is always fetched regardless of this setting.

errors.saveEnabled: Failed to save webapp enabled setting: {error}
errors.deviceBusyMaxRetries: Device busy (429), gave up after {retries} retries

fields.time: current Unix time (if NTP is configured)
fields.minimumfreeHeap10min: lowest free heap in the current 10 minute window
fields.heapLowErrUptime: number of low-heap guard hits since boot
fields.heapLowErr10min: number of low-heap guard hits in the current 10 minute window
fields.mdnsReplies: number of mDNS packets replied to
